page.title: Approvals
page.subtitle: Review and act on requests routed through the approval workflow.

myPending.empty: Nothing is waiting on your decision right now.

empty.title: No approval requests yet
empty.description: Requests created by other modules (leave, finance, transfers…) will appear here.

approveDialog.title: Approve this step?
approveDialog.description: This moves the request to its next step, or fully approves it if this was the last one.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this request?
rejectDialog.description: Rejecting any step rejects the whole request — it can't continue to later steps.

executeDialog.title: Execute this request?
executeDialog.description: This carries out the action the request was approved for.

cancelDialog.title: Withdraw this request?
cancelDialog.description: Only you, as the requester, can withdraw it, and only while it's still pending review.

toasts.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
